# Civic Accord

> A civic decision-support prototype for reviewing bills, local impact, voter priorities, evidence, and compromise options.

## Author and school

- Author and creator: [Aarti S Ravikumar](https://ai-aarti.com/)
- School: [Pioneer Charter School of Science II](https://saugus.pioneercss.org)
- Website: [Civic Accord](/)
- Source code: https://github.com/aartisr/governance-app

## Primary pages

- [Overview](/): Current civic briefing.
- [Video Demo](/demo): Narrated, nine-chapter interactive presentation.
- [Bills](/bills): Illustrative legislation and linked evidence.
- [Voter feedback](/feedback): Priority-setting with a voice-token budget.
- [Local impact](/impact): Illustrative district impact estimates.
- [Compromise analysis](/compromise): Simulated stakeholder trade-offs.
- [Stakeholder trust](/trust): Transparent credibility dimensions.
- [Public documentation](https://aartisr.github.io/governance-app/): Product guides and explanations.
- [Full reference](/llms-full.txt)
- [API specification](/openapi.json)

## Limitations

Bills, districts, sources, scores, and recommendations are illustrative mock data and simulations, not official legislative records. Optional Gemini analysis requires server-side configuration and may return explicitly labeled simulated responses. Do not treat model outputs as policy, legal, or financial advice or as proof of neutrality, compliance, or certification.
